_evidence: Overlay for 0x0042c1f4 (esi = car A, ebx = car B, both rec[0x66fef0,0x41c,0..21]; edi = segment rec 0..25; compose LAST, after the 0x42cd1e family list and ring_0042c1f4). The engage block 0x42c291..0x42c577 ran in about 1 case in 150: its gates are 'test byte [esi+0x9c],2; jne' (0x42c284), |movsx B+0x90| < movsx B+0xb0 + 0x100 and the same for A (0x42c2b0/0x42c2d5, jge exit; full-range words passed about 1 in 4), 'test byte [edi+0x51],0x80; je exit' (0x42c2db; the spec segment record, set in 1/4 before) and |[0x603e70]| <= [0x603b52] (0x42c326, jg exit), where [0x603e70] = B+0xe2 - A+0xe2 when neither car has +0x9c bit 1 (0x42c23d, also 0x42beea). So per car: +0x90 -0x200..0x200 and +0xb0 0..0x400 (both orders of the 0x42c2ae/0x42c2d3 compares and of the 0x42c672..0x42c698 / 0x42c8d1..0x42c8fd 0x200 margins), +0xe2 -0x200..0x200, +0x9c bit 1 clear in 6/8, +0x8d bit 1 clear in 6/8 (0x42b17e sets [0x603e6e] = 0, the 0x42c277 gate, only when neither car has it; also 0x42bae4/0x42ba87 stc and 0x42c6df/0x42c951); the engage-block flag bytes +0x135 (bit 1 at 0x42c2e5/0x42c33c, OR-ed bits 2..5 later), +0x137 bit 6 (0x42c2ee), +0xce bit 7 (0x42c2f7), +0x179 bits 2 (0x42c333) and 7 (0x42c5ec/0x42c84b) and +0x122 bit 2 (0x42c399/0x42c412/0x42c496/0x42c50c) take both values often. Byte +0x1ce bit 0 (0x42c6ec/0x42c95e jne exit) clear in 5/7; words +0x11c / +0x11e -0x200..0x600 so 'abs(B+0x90) - B+0x11c/+0x11e; jns exit' (0x42c733/0x42c9a5) passes about half the time and the A-side sums (0x42cb33 jns, 0x42cc2b jns, 0x42ca40 / 0x42c7d2 against 0x240) take both signs. Segment records 0..25 byte +0x51: bit 7 set in 8/10 (0x42c2db), bits 6 (0x42c349/0x42c384), 5 and 3 (0x42beea 0x42bfb9..0x42c011) both. Words [0x603b52] 0..0x800 (|603e70| bound; 0x42c5cf / 0x42c82e subtract it from [0x603e70], both signs), [0x603dae] -0x800..0x800 (0x42c306 jge), [0x603da8] / [0x603da6] -0x800..0x800 (0x42c3c2 / 0x42c43b / 0x42c4bf / 0x42c531 jl) and [0x603dac] 0..0x800 (0x42c650 / 0x42c8af jl): fuzzed dwords put them far outside the 16-bit differences they are compared with. All of these are flag bytes, compared words or segment flag bytes (tests, cmp, OR/AND): nothing is dereferenced, indexed or divided, so every value is valid.
